messages.subject_clean: No D-RUG this week. Post your questions on our Discourse!
messages.body_plain:
We will not be having D-RUG this week but DataLab will still be open for socializing etc during Tea Time (1-2pm) and Co-working (2-4pm). Given that, this is a great time to acquaint yourself with our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> forum, where you can ask all your R questions asynchronously.

Tea Time: 1-2pm, DataLab Classroom, Library 360
Co-working: 2-4pm, DataLab Classroom Room, Library 360

Have a good week,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators

messages.subject: D-RUG and Tea Time this Thursday!
messages.subject_clean: D-RUG and Tea Time this Thursday!
messages.body_plain:
Hi D-RUGgies!

We will be meeting this Thursday (2/20) from 10-noon virtually and in person in the DataLab classroom (Library 360). This is a group working session so come with your questions for our expeRts, or just bring your laptop and get in some distraction free R-coding time. Additionally, if there are topics you would like to see someone do a deeper dive on, let us know!

Datalab will also be open Thursday afternoon for the last Tea Time and Co-working of the quarter.

D-RUG: 10am-noon, DataLab Classroom, Library 360, and zoom https://ucdavis.zoom.us/j/96397082218?pwd=S0JXcW5hcUFkbTcwMHFQV1NVNkg3Zz09
Tea Time: 1-2pm, DataLab Classroom, Library 360
Co-working: 2-4pm, DataLab Classroom Room, Library 360

Please consider posting your questions to our Discourse <https://d-rug.discourse.group/> site in advance of attending D-RUG virtually. This helps us do a better job of answering your questions, and also keep a log of the types of questions we see frequently.

See you then,

Your D-RUG Coo[R]dinators
